def check_k_1():
    n = 3
    m = 2
    s = -0.5
    a = 3 * (2**(n-1))
    b = 3 * (2**(m-1))
    
    # f(x) = a(x-s)^n + s
    # g(x) = b(x-s)^m + s
    
    import sympy as sp
    x = sp.symbols('x')
    f = a * (x - s)**n + s
    g = b * (x - s)**m + s
    
    # Check if f and g have integer coefficients
    f_expanded = sp.expand(f)
    g_expanded = sp.expand(g)
    
    f_coeffs = f_expanded.as_poly(x).coeffs()
    g_coeffs = g_expanded.as_poly(x).coeffs()
    
    print(f"f coefficients: {f_coeffs}")
    print(f"g coefficients: {g_coeffs}")
    
    # Check if they are integers
    all_int_f = all(float(c).is_integer() for c in f_coeffs)
    all_int_g = all(float(c).is_integer() for c in g_coeffs)
    print(f"f all int: {all_int_f}")
    print(f"g all int: {all_int_g}")
    
    # Check f(g(x)) - 3*g(f(x))
    diff = sp.expand(f.subs(x, g) - 3 * g.subs(x, f))
    print(f"f(g(x)) - 3g(f(x)) = {diff}")

check_k_1()
